{{Top|leg}}
The '''Accuracy scope''' was a type of [[Scope/Legends|scope]] that increased the effectiveness of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], and [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]] by allowing the user to focus more precisely on the target. These scopes offered better magnification, meaning that even the humblest of blaster pistols could theoretically be made into a sniping weapon. The Mark I, II, III, and IV scopes in turn allowed for increasingly significant boosts in accuracy over longer ranges.
